# ----------------------------- Stan model -----------------------------
# Prepare Stan data
stan_data <- list(
  N = nrow(df_filtered),
  D = length(unique(df_filtered$District)),
  district_id = df_filtered$district_id,
  y = df_filtered$SAM,
  p_hyperprior = c(1, 100),       # daily p ~ Beta(1, 100)
  gamma_hyperprior = c(5, 2.5),   # same
  alpha_hyperprior = c(5,2.5),     # same
  start_index = which(!duplicated(df_filtered$district_id))
)

  
print(df_filtered)

df_filtered <- df_filtered[!is.na(df_filtered$District), ]
tail(df_filtered)
nrow(df_filtered)  # Should be 666

district_starts <- which(!duplicated(df_filtered$district_id))
print(district_starts)
stan_data$start_index = district_starts


# Run the model
setwd("C:/Users/ecemy/Desktop/Waste prediction/Code/Hierarchical model/daily model")

fit <- stan(
  file = "hierarchical_discrete_model_daily.stan",
  data = stan_data,
  chains = 4,
  warmup = 5000,
  iter = 10000,
  cores = 4,
  seed = 123
)

# Extract posterior samples
posterior <- rstan::extract(fit)

print(fit)

posterior_array <- as.array(fit)

#---------  Print the prior and posterior distributions of parameters ---------
plot_param_by_district_with_prior <- function(samples, param_name, district_names, prior_fn = NULL, output_dir = "plots") {
  dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

  if (is.null(dim(samples))) {
    samples <- matrix(samples, ncol = 1)
  }

  param_df <- as.data.frame(samples)
  colnames(param_df) <- district_names[1:ncol(param_df)]
  param_df_long <- pivot_longer(param_df, everything(), names_to = "District", values_to = "value")

  # Set x-axis values for prior curves
  if (param_name %in% c("p", "beta1")) {
    x_vals <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)
    prior_df <- expand.grid(value = x_vals, District = unique(param_df_long$District)) %>%
      mutate(density = if (!is.null(prior_fn)) prior_fn(value) else NA_real_)
  } else if (!is.null(prior_fn)) {
    prior_df <- param_df_long %>%
      group_by(District) %>%
      summarise(min_x = min(value), max_x = max(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(prior_curve = list({
        x_vals_local <- seq(min_x, max_x, length.out = 200)
        tibble(value = x_vals_local, density = prior_fn(x_vals_local), District = District)
      })) %>%
      pull(prior_curve) %>%
      bind_rows()
  }

  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(param_df_long, aes(x = value)) +
    geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(density)), fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.6)

  if (!is.null(prior_fn)) {
    p <- p + geom_line(data = prior_df, aes(x = value, y = density), color = "red", linetype = "dashed")
  }

  facet_mode <- if (param_name %in% c("p", "beta1")) "free_y" else "free"

  p <- p + facet_wrap(~District, scales = facet_mode) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Posterior", if (!is.null(prior_fn)) "vs Prior", "", "for", param_name),
      x = paste(param_name, "value"),
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(output_dir, "/", param_name, "_posterior", if (!is.null(prior_fn)) "_vs_prior", "_all_districts.jpg"),
    plot = p, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300
  )
}

# For each parameter
plot_param_by_district_with_prior(
  samples = posterior$p,
  param_name = "p",
  district_names = district_names,
  prior_fn = function(x) dbeta(x, 3, 2)
)

plot_param_by_district_with_prior(
  samples = posterior$gamma,
  param_name = "gamma",
  district_names = district_names,
  prior_fn = function(x) dlnorm(x, 5, 2.5)
)

plot_param_by_district_with_prior(
  samples = posterior$alpha,
  param_name = "alpha",
  district_names = district_names,
  prior_fn = function(x) dlnorm(x, 0, 5)
)

plot_param_by_district_with_prior(posterior$beta0, "beta0", district_names)
plot_param_by_district_with_prior(posterior$beta1, "beta1", district_names)


# -------  Time varying K ------- 
# Step 1: Prepare K_long with iteration-level data
K_long <- posterior$K %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(iteration = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -iteration,
    names_to = "Index",
    values_to = "K"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Index = as.integer(gsub("V", "", Index))) %>%
  left_join(
    df_filtered %>% mutate(Index = row_number()) %>%
      select(Index, District, Month, Year),
    by = "Index"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = paste(Year, Month, sep = "-"))

# Ensure proper factor levels for time
K_long$Timepoint <- factor(K_long$Timepoint, levels = unique(K_long$Timepoint))

# Step 2: Summarise to get median and 95% CI
K_summary <- K_long %>%
  group_by(District, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    K_median = median(K),
    K_lower = quantile(K, 0.025),
    K_upper = quantile(K, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 3: Plot
p <- ggplot(K_summary, aes(x = Timepoint, y = K_median, group = District)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = K_lower, ymax = K_upper), fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~District, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Time-varying K with 95% Credible Intervals",
    x = "Time",
    y = "K"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

# Save to file
ggsave("plots/K_time_series_per_district.jpg", plot = p, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
# Also display in RStudio
#print(p)

# R-hat Values (Gelman-Rubin Diagnostic)
summary(fit)$summary[, "Rhat"]

# Effective Sample Size (ESS): Low ESS → low precision
summary(fit)$summary[, "n_eff"]

param_summary <- summary(fit)$summary
rhat_values <- param_summary[, "Rhat"]
ess_values <- param_summary[, "n_eff"]

# Print or save key ones
print(rhat_values[c("p[1]", "gamma[1]", "alpha[1]", "P0[1]")])
print(ess_values[c("p[1]", "gamma[1]", "alpha[1]", "P0[1]")])

# ------- export parameters to csv ------- 
# Step 1: Extract per-district medians
param_medians <- tibble(
  District = district_names,
  beta0 = apply(posterior$beta0, 2, median),
  beta1 = apply(posterior$beta1, 2, median),
  p = apply(posterior$p, 2, median),
  gamma = apply(posterior$gamma, 2, median),
  alpha = apply(posterior$alpha, 2, median)
)

# Step 2: Add district info to K values
K_long <- posterior$K %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(iteration = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -iteration, names_to = "Index", values_to = "K") %>%
  mutate(Index = as.integer(gsub("V", "", Index)))

df_filtered_indexed <- df_filtered %>%
  mutate(Index = row_number()) %>%
  select(Index, District)

K_long <- K_long %>%
  left_join(df_filtered_indexed, by = "Index")

# Step 3: Median K per district & collapse into string
K_medians_vector <- K_long %>%
  group_by(District, Index) %>%
  summarise(K_median = median(K), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(District) %>%
  summarise(K_series = paste0("[", paste(format(round(K_median, 2), nsmall = 2), collapse = ", "), "]"))

# Step 4: Merge with parameter medians
final_summary <- param_medians %>%
  left_join(K_medians_vector, by = "District")

# Step 5: Save to CSV
write_csv(final_summary, "outputs/parameter_and_K_series_summary.csv")
# ------- end of export parameters to csv -------

    breaks = c(0, seq(5000, 50000, by = 5000), Inf),
    labels = c(
      "0–5k", "5k–10k", "10k–15k", "15k–20k", "20k–25k",
      "25k–30k", "30k–35k", "35k–40k", "40k–45k", "45k–50k", ">50k"
    ),
    right = FALSE,
    include.lowest = TRUE
  ))

# ---- STEP 2: Define a manual color scale (last color = red) ----
burden_colors <- c(
  "0–5k" = "#ffffcc",
  "5k–10k" = "#d9f0a3",
  "10k–15k" = "#addd8e",
  "15k–20k" = "#78c679",
  "20k–25k" = "#41ab5d",
  "25k–30k" = "#238443",
  "30k–35k" = "#006837",
  "35k–40k" = "#005a32",
  "40k–45k" = "#004529",
  "45k–50k" = "#00351f",
  ">50k" = "red"
)

# ---- STEP 3: Plot burden with custom bins and color ----
p_burden_binned <- ggplot(map_burden_all) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = burden_bin), color = "black", size=0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~Timepoint, ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = burden_colors,
    na.value = "grey80",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Burden per District",
    fill = "Burden Range"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

ggsave("plots/burden_faceted_binned_5k.jpg", plot = p_burden_binned, width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# --------- Map of Duration ---------

# --------- Map of Duration (Daily Model, Matched Style) ---------

# Step 1: Compute median duration (convert from days to months)
duration_df_daily <- tibble(
  District = district_names,
  duration = (1 / apply(posterior$p, 2, median)) / 30  # Convert from days to months
)

# Step 2: Add shapefile-compatible names
duration_df_daily$Shapefile_District_Name <- district_name_mapping[duration_df_daily$District]

# Step 3: Join with shapefile
map_duration_daily <- left_join(somalia_map, duration_df_daily, by = "Shapefile_District_Name") %>%
  filter(!is.na(duration))

# Step 4: Define fixed bins and colors (same as original)
duration_breaks <- c(0, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5, Inf)
duration_labels <- c("0-3.5", "3.5-4", "4-4.5", "4.5-5", "5<")

duration_colors <- c(
  "0-3.5" = "#ffffcc",
  "3.5-4" = "#c2e699",
  "4-4.5" = "#78c679",
  "4.5-5" = "#238443",
  "5<"    = "red"
)

map_duration_daily <- map_duration_daily %>%
  mutate(duration_bin = cut(
    duration,
    breaks = duration_breaks,
    labels = duration_labels,
    right = FALSE,
    include.lowest = TRUE
  ))

# Step 5: Plot
p_duration_daily <- ggplot(map_duration_daily) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = duration_bin), color = "black", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = duration_colors,
    na.value = "grey80",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Duration per District (Daily Model, Months)",
    fill = "Duration (Months)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

# Step 6: Save
ggsave("plots/duration_map_binned_daily.jpg", plot = p_duration_daily, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
